lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gills are arranged in a multi-row grid; three prominent spots immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit form a scalene triangle orientation.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs; grid-like anchor nodes are clearly visible where the second vertical band crosses the primary horizontal spot clusters.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature with a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (high luminance above, low luminance below) runs horizontally across the upper flank from the dorsal margin of the gills.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A V-shaped indentation or notch is visible at the extreme distal tip of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A non-solid, semi-circular pale pixel cluster is visible in the mid-posterior quadrant of the pectoral fin's surface.
